Creative Drive

Hi, I'm Riboy — a creative who builds and designs.

With 2 years of professional experience, my journey started as a UI/UX Designer and Front-end Developer during my internship — designing user-centered interfaces and bringing them to life through code.

My first full-time role expanded my creative toolkit as a Web and Graphic Designer, where I produced promotional banners, social media content, marketing materials, and HTML email campaigns using FastTrack — designing responsive emails with HTML and CSS from scratch.

  • I create pixel-perfect visual assets aligned with brand strategy and marketing goals — from social content to print-ready materials.
  • I design clean, accessible UI systems that prioritize user experience and ease of navigation across all screen sizes.
  • I build responsive, standards-compliant HTML/CSS front-ends and coded email templates that render beautifully everywhere.
  • I bring strategic thinking to every deliverable — balancing aesthetics, function, and business impact.
